Dust Test, Type DustEvent ST 
IP ratings from the IEC 60529 and ISO 20653 standards are used to evaluate how well an enclosure is able to resist the entry of dust and liquids.
Our DustEvent test chambers are designed to conduct IP tests according to the necessary standards: DIN EN 60529 (IP5X / IP6X), ISO 20653 (IP5KX / IP6KX), and SAE J 575.
Additionally, with the right equipment, dust chambers can also meet other standards such as MIL STD 810 or EN 60068-2-68.
